toolSpec.name: get_product_price
toolSpec.description: Retrieve the current listing price for a product in a given marketplace.

product_id.description: Product identifier starting with 'P' followed by 5 alphanumeric characters (e.g., P12H3I)

toolSpec.name: get_product_description
toolSpec.description: Retrieve the current product description from the catalog.

product_id.description: Product identifier starting with 'P' followed by 5 alphanumeric characters (e.g., P12H3I)

toolSpec.name: get_product_description_from_image
toolSpec.description: Analyze a product image stored in S3 and return a description of the product.

product_id.description: Product identifier starting with 'P' followed by 5 alphanumeric characters (e.g., P12H3I)

s3_url.description: S3 URI to the product image (e.g., s3://bucket/key)

summarize.description: Whether to return a summarized description

toolSpec.name: get_inventory_status
toolSpec.description: Retrieve current inventory status for a product, optionally including forecasts.

product_id.description: Product identifier starting with 'P' followed by 5 alphanumeric characters (e.g., P12H3I)

toolSpec.name: get_product_listing_status
toolSpec.description: Retrieve the current listing status for a product, optionally including recent status history.

product_id.description: Product identifier starting with 'P' followed by 5 alphanumeric characters (e.g., P12H3I)

include_history.description: Whether to include listing status history
